title: Deformation of the absolute Galois groups of number fields
summary: The technical goal of this paper is to construct and study profinite monoids DG_K for number fields K such that (1) the unit group of DG_K is isomorphic to the absolute Galois group G_K; (2) the maximal abelian quotient of DG_K is isomorphic to the Deligne-Ribet monoid DR_K; (3) the idempotents of DG_K bijectively correspond to subsets of the set P_K of (finite) primes of K; (4) the maximal Galois groups G_{K, S} with restricted ramifications S all appear as maximal closed subgroups of DG_K at idempotents; (5) all maximal closed subgroups of DG_K at idempotents are of this form.
